observations.method: 11 shoulder sections with 9 transverse lines each, 25 floor probes and 21 probes one grid cell inside the three open stock edges.

requirements.reason: No roughness, material physics or general GD&T evaluator.

limitations: One Z-aligned flat step open at three stock edges, with a single retained shoulder.
11 sections, 25 interior probes and 21 near-edge probes are finite samples, not continuous GD&T.
Near-edge probes are one declared grid cell inside the stock, not an all-surface edge-clearance proof.
Two grid cells are a numerical guard, not certified uncertainty.
No roughness, fixtures, holder or material physics.
